## Data

The data at hand is monthly unemployments rates from Jan 1, 1976, from FRED.

```{r}
library(tidyquant)
library(tidyverse)

# unemp_raw <- tq_get(
#   c("UNRATE", "ORUR", "CAUR", "TXUR", "NYUR"),
#   get  = "economic.data",
#   from = "1976-01-01"
# )
# 
# head(unemp_raw)
# 
# dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
# 
# write_rds(unemp_raw, "data/unemp_raw.rds")

unemp_raw = read_rds("data/unemp_raw.rds")

head(unemp_raw)
```

## wrangling

I renamed price to unemployment_rate for this graph, and added region names. I also filled in missing oct 2025 values with sept 2025. I also created a month to month change for each region.

```{r}
library(knitr)

unemp <- unemp_raw |>
  rename(unemployment_rate = price) |>
  mutate(
    region = case_when(
      symbol == "UNRATE" ~ "United States",
      symbol == "ORUR"   ~ "Oregon",
      symbol == "CAUR"   ~ "California",
      symbol == "TXUR"   ~ "Texas",
      symbol == "NYUR"   ~ "New York"
    )
  )

unemp <- unemp |>
  arrange(region, date) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(
    unemployment_rate = replace(
      unemployment_rate,
      date == as.Date("2025-10-01"),
      unemployment_rate[date == as.Date("2025-09-01")]
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

unemp <- unemp |>
  arrange(region, date) |>
  group_by(region) |>
  mutate(unemployment_rate_change = unemployment_rate - lag(unemployment_rate)) |>
  ungroup()

unemp_recent <- unemp |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("2015-01-01"))

unemp_summary <- unemp |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarize(
    mean_rate = mean(unemployment_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rate  = min(unemployment_rate,  na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rate  = max(unemployment_rate,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )

unemp_recent_summary <- unemp_recent |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarize(
    mean_rate = mean(unemployment_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_rate  = min(unemployment_rate,  na.rm = TRUE),
    max_rate  = max(unemployment_rate,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )

unemp_no_covid <- unemp |>
  filter(lubridate::year(date) != 2020)

unemp_top_increases_no_covid <- unemp_no_covid |>
  slice_max(unemployment_rate_change, n = 5)

unemp_top_decreases_no_covid <- unemp_no_covid |>
  slice_min(unemployment_rate_change, n = 5)
```

## This graph shows the mean, min, and max unemp rate for each region across the full sample. 

```{r}
kable(unemp_summary, digits = 2)
```

## This table is the same as above but only 015 onward. 

```{r}
kable(unemp_recent_summary, digits = 2)
```

## This table doesn't have 2020 (covic), and shows the 5 largest month-to-month increases across all regions.

```{r}
kable(unemp_top_increases_no_covid, digits = 2)
```

## This table shows the 5 largest month to month decreases across all regions (no 2020)

```{r}
kable(unemp_top_decreases_no_covid, digits = 2)
```

## Visualization

## This plot shows the monthly unemployment rate for all five regions on one chart. 
 

```{r}
ggplot(unemp, aes(x = date, y = unemployment_rate, color = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Unemployment Rate by Region",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Unemployment Rate (%)",
    color = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

This plot shows the same data but a seperate panel for ecah region.

```{r}
ggplot(unemp, aes(x = date, y = unemployment_rate, color = region)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ region) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Unemployment Rate by Region",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Unemployment Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

This shows the avg unemp rate for each region over the full sample, from lowest to highest.

```{r}
ggplot(unemp_summary, aes(x = fct_reorder(region, mean_rate), y = mean_rate)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Unemployment Rate by Region",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Mean Unemployment Rate (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

This plot shows the full sample avg next to the post-2015 avg.

```{r}
bind_rows(
  unemp_summary |> mutate(period = "Full Sample"),
  unemp_recent_summary |> mutate(period = "2015 Onward")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(region, mean_rate), y = mean_rate, fill = period)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Average Unemployment Rate: Full Sample vs. 2015 Onward",
    x = "Region",
    y = "Mean Unemployment Rate (%)",
    fill = "Period"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
